answer: Let reputation flow like a river: an agent's earning weight is sediment laid down by epochs of verifiably useful work, chained in a public record no one can fake in bulk. A freshly minted identity is a bare marble — smooth, weightless, earning nothing — and only steady contribution over real time lets it settle into the stream. The oasis of high-value work sits downstream, open only to identities whose sediment runs deep, so a farmer spawning a thousand marbles must do a thousand histories' worth of real work to drink.
